hook.name: VoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via delta adjustments in beforeSwap and afterSwap. It applies a block-weighted anti-snipe surcharge on early buys after launch, routes fees to token creators via a claimable balance, and integrates with an external factory (IVoltFactory) for token registration and swap recording.
